boundary_evidence: The class's complete member set in one contiguous run: GetClsnID begins the run at 0x02037f4c and C2 ends it at 0x020381cc; the six accessors/setters between them were enrolled as anonymous func_ shards whose first parameter is the dBgPi result record and whose bodies only touch its fields.
func_02037f44 at 0x02037f44 is excluded: notes in src/actors/daMky_c.cpp record that it returns word 8 of a different record type (a dBgPi local would emit C1, which those bodies do not call).
func_020381cc after C2 walks the collider table through a pointer-to-pointer argument, not a dBgPi receiver, and belongs to the CLPS_BlockRef neighbourhood that follows.

compiler_only_output.reason: dBgPi's emitted _ZTI names its dBgPc base through this pointer, so mwcc emits the base's typeinfo as vague linkage even though non-polymorphic dBgPc has no vtable of its own. The cartridge record at arm9:0x0209921c is proved by romdata_check before isolation discards the copy.
The base's type-name string, emitted alongside _ZTI5dBgPc for the same vague-linkage reason; equals the cartridge record at arm9:0x02099214.

The destructor is the key function, so the TU emits the class's two-slot vtable (D1, D0). The cartridge copy lives at arm9:0x02099368 -- the _ZTV5dBgPi alias the C1/C2 vptr store relocates against -- and romdata_check proves every slot before isolation discards this copy.

Emitted with the vtable group for the same key-function reason; the cartridge's single-inheritance record is arm9:0x02099230 and its relocations (abi class vptr, _ZTS5dBgPi, base _ZTI5dBgPc) are proved by romdata_check.
The emitted type-name string equals the cartridge's record at arm9:0x0209920c -- the class carries the ROM's own dBgPi spelling, not a coined name -- so the copy is discarded after proof.

notes: Eight members arrived as anonymous func_ shards; symbols.txt now names them by their member spellings. GetColliderIndex/SetColliderIndex read and write colliderIdx -- the slot in the 0x18-entry registered-collider table at data_020a0c80 -- and IsValid/HasCollider are the two validity tests the registry helpers run on it. SetCollider records the hitting collider's identity triplet (its slot, ownerUniqueID, owner and the collider pointer); IsHitBy compares that triplet.

All five ABI variants are cartridge-retained: dBgCh_Gnd/Lin/SphCrr construct their dBgPi result sub-object as a non-primary base (calls C2, destroys via D2) while complete dBgPi locals use C1/D1. Deferred codegen emits D2,D0,D1 then C1,C2, matching the ROM order.
func_02037de8 (the five-word surface-record copy RecordHit calls) stays an extern: it lives in the SurfaceInfo/dBgPc cluster below this span and is a different TU's job.
